title: Pressure Sensor Signal Anomaly / Out of Range
meaning: The primary discharge pressure sensor (PT-204) feedback signal has deviated by more than 15% from the expected operational threshold (4.5–8.0 bar).
probable_causes: Faulty or loose wiring connection on pressure sensor PT-204
Sensor membrane blockage or cavitation in hydraulic line
recommended_checks: Step 1: Inspect pressure sensor PT-204 wiring harness and terminal block for loose contacts or moisture.
Step 2: Verify sensor reading against manual analog gauge PI-204.
Step 3: Perform zero-point calibration if analog reading matches physical pressure.
Step 4: Check hydraulic line filter for clogging before replacing transducer.

title: Thermal Overload Warning
meaning: Winding temperature on drive motor exceeds 85°C continuously for over 3 minutes.
recommended_checks: Check cooling fan cowl for debris.
Verify ventilation intake filters are clean.
Measure motor phase currents using clamp meter.

title: Vibration Threshold Exceeded
meaning: Vibration sensor detects RMS velocity > 7.1 mm/s on drive non-drive end bearing.
recommended_checks: Inspect bearing grease condition for metal particulates.
